name: Toshiba International Corporation
old_description: Toshiba International Corporation manufactures a wide range of electrical equipment, including low- and medium-voltage switchgear, motors, drives and controllers. Switchgear products are used in power distribution and control applications.
about:
Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) was established in 1975 in Houston, Texas, as the U.S. manufacturing subsidiary of Japan's Toshiba Corporation. The company operates from its Houston headquarters with a workforce of 500 to 999 employees.

TIC manufactures low- and medium-voltage motors, switchgear, drives, and controllers. Its product portfolio also includes high-performance motors for extreme-duty applications, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics such as uninterruptible power supply (UPS) units and solar inverters. The facility supports production across these lines, though specific floor space and annual volumes are not disclosed.

The company serves the power generation, industrial, and energy sectors, with motors and drives deployed in oil and gas operations, general manufacturing, water treatment plants, and sustainable transportation projects. Its UPS and energy storage solutions provide backup power for data centers, healthcare facilities, and other mission-critical installations. Hybrid vehicle systems support automotive original equipment manufacturers.

TIC emphasizes innovation and reliability, positioning its technologies as enabling a resilient future through efficiency gains in motor performance, hybrid propulsion, and power electronics. The division was created to deliver manufacturing and infrastructure solutions that complement Toshiba's broader energy and electronics portfolio in the Americas.
